title: Cozy house in Gallatin city limits
description:
Gallatin clean and cozy house with 2 bedrooms with 1 bath in quiet neighborhood 3 miles to downtown square in Gallatin and 30 minutes from Nashville.  Fully stocked kitchen including spices.

The space
Our family has been renting short term rentals for many years and have tried to equip the house with the items we like to find in a Airbnb.  
Fast WIFI  - 1 gig +
Desk and love seat in office room.    
Gas grill 
2 picnic tables, one covered.
Plenty of parking
Keurig combo coffee pot with drip and pods. 
Smart TV with NetFlix, Prime, Roku, Parmount + and Hulu already logged in.

Guest access
Guest have access to entire house.   Garage is not accessable.
